d:
Lead the teams that decide how fast Plaid can say yes to AI

AI agents are starting to manage money, and Plaid sits between them and the financial system. Fintechs and frontier AI labs are asking us for more data and new ways to use it, and their users expect tools that act on their behalf. Meeting that demand depends on the systems two teams build. We are looking for the Engineering Manager to lead them.

Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo and SoFi and many of the largest banks, across a network of 12,000 financial institutions in the US, Canada, UK, and Europe.

That network is built by Connectivity, the org that builds and operates the systems connecting Plaid products to financial institutions and their data. It’s the foundation under everything Plaid does, including the AI experiences our customers are now asking us to power.

Within Connectivity, Supply & Traffic own two foundational levers:

- Supply: which institutions and data Plaid can reach.

- Traffic: when and how Plaid retrieves and refreshes that data.

Together they decide whether data is there, fresh, and affordable for every product at Plaid. As demand grows, they decide how fast Plaid can say yes.

The work is building reliable systems that discover and onboard new data sources, then making increasingly automated decisions about what to retrieve, when, and at what cost.

Two things make the next 18 months pivotal: traffic management and optimization move into the group in early 2027, and discovery and retrieval decisions shift from rules to ML models. You’ll own the strategy for both, grow the teams, and work closely with the product and ML engineers who depend on them.

Responsibilities:

- You will lead 2 teams of 4 engineers (8 in total), ranging from junior to Staff and including an ML engineer, developing them through clear goal setting, coaching, and feedback.

- You’ll define and drive the long-term strategy for this focus area, in close partnership with technical and product leaders across Plaid.

- You’ll collaborate with cross-functional partners to identify high-leverage opportunities, shape the roadmap, and dive deep into technical design and execution details to ensure consistent delivery of high-impact business outcomes.

- You’ll lead the transition of traffic management and optimization into the team in early 2027 and own its roadmap across charged access and first-party initiatives.

- You’ll drive automation and AI/ML-powered approaches to discovering new data (Constellation) and to deciding how and when Plaid retrieves it.

- You’ll uphold a high bar for technical quality and delivery velocity, leading by example..

Qualifications:

- 8+ years of industry experience, that includes time as a Staff-level engineer before transitioning into management.

- 1+ years of engineering management experience

- Deep experience designing scalable, reliable architectures that support real-world products at scale.

- Experience building or leading teams that ship ML- or AI-driven systems in production.

- Track record of building and growing high performing engineering teams (either as an engineer or a manager).
